clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Enchanted Gaea Seeds are prepared for the Charred Vale. Druidic magic gives them strength to take root in ash-choked soil and begin restoring Kalimdor's ravaged land.

The Horde's druids are trying to heal the deep scars across Stonetalon Mountains. At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield enchants raw Gaea Seeds so they can withstand corruption and elemental blight. Planted in the fertile dirt mounds beneath the Charred Vale's soot, they take root despite the harsh land. Hostile fire elementals and invasive harpies still dominate the vale.

Planting the seeds is part of the struggle for Stonetalon's future. Their enchanted husks resist lingering corruption and give native plants a foothold. The returning vegetation is meant to soothe agitated fire elementals, crowd out feral harpies, and counter the deforestation caused by the Venture Company's relentless logging.
